title: How the browser is reached
description: The entrypoints a reader or a link uses: the page's address, the part after #, and the token panel.

entities.name: Open a repository
entities.description: Reads and shows the repository the address names.
entities.transport: ?url=<address> in the page's address, or the landing page's form, which sets it
entities.authorization: None: the page has no sign-in. What a repository shows is up to its host and the reader's token.
entities.result: The folder tree, and the folder named after # or the shallowest one.
failures: The address is not http or https, or names no repository.
The host refuses: no such repository or ref, a private repository without a token, a token refused, or GitHub's unauthenticated limit used up.
No .dev/*.json file is under the folder asked for.

entities.name: Open a folder
entities.description: Shows one folder's views and knowledge.
entities.authorization: None: the page has no sign-in. What a repository shows is up to its host and the reader's token.
entities.result: The folder's head and its tabs, on the kind already open if it has one.
failures: A folder the page has no files for opens the shallowest folder instead.

entities.name: Open a part
entities.description: Shows one part of a drawing in the inspector.
entities.authorization: None: the page has no sign-in. What a repository shows is up to its host and the reader's token.
entities.result: The kind's tab opens, the drawing scrolls to the middle of the screen and the part is selected, pulsed and inspected.
failures: Nothing is selected when no drawn part of that kind has that ID or name.

entities.name: Open a view
entities.description: Scrolls to one view in a folder.
entities.authorization: None: the page has no sign-in. What a repository shows is up to its host and the reader's token.
entities.result: The view's tab opens and the page scrolls to it.
failures: Nothing moves when the folder has no such file.

entities.name: Open a record
entities.description: Scrolls to one knowledge record, or one knowledge file.
entities.authorization: None: the page has no sign-in. What a repository shows is up to its host and the reader's token.
entities.result: The Knowledge tab opens, the page scrolls to the record and it flashes; without #<record ID>, to the file.
failures: An unknown record ID scrolls to the file.
Nothing moves when the folder has no such file.

entities.name: Open Waiting
entities.description: Shows every open decision and blocker in the repository.
entities.authorization: None: the page has no sign-in. What a repository shows is up to its host and the reader's token.
entities.result: Two tables, of open decisions and of blockers, each row linked to its record.

entities.name: Save a token
entities.description: Keeps a token for a scope and reloads with it.
entities.transport: the token panel's Save and reload, or Enter in its field
entities.authorization: The reader, in their own browser.
entities.result: The token replaces any other for that scope, in this tab or this browser, and the page reloads.
failures: The browser won't store it, and the status line says so.

entities.name: Forget a token
entities.description: Removes a token from this tab and this browser.
entities.transport: Forget beside a token in the token panel
entities.authorization: The reader, in their own browser.
entities.result: The token is gone from both; the page reloads if it was the one in use.
